prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Upload blogs on WordPress, set up AIOSEO, SEO expert
I have about 30 blogs and listings that need to get uploaded to WordPress and AIOSEO set up correctly for each page. - Needs to know how to use WordPress - AIOSEO - SEO
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Booking platform for fitness studios
client: Pulsebox Studios
client_industry: fitness
start: 2020-03
end: 2020-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma
- Stripe
built: A white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable
  and memberships.
metrics:
- 64 studios onboarded in 6 months
- 71% checkout conversion

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Booking platform for fitness studios (p01).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience helping businesses build and manage web content and applications.

I’d be glad to help upload your blogs and listings to WordPress and set up AIOSEO properly for each page. I’m comfortable working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m used to handling structured, detail-oriented web work carefully.

One relevant project was a booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios, where I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, and memberships. That platform onboarded 64 studios in 6 months and achieved a 71% checkout conversion.

I can bring the same organized approach to your WordPress uploads and SEO setup, making sure each page is configured correctly and consistently.
